svg.metadata: {"id": "s034", "name": "测量操场", "cat": "数学", "tags": ["数学", "测量", "长度单位", "户外"], "desc": "晴朗操场上拉开一条 0–10 米卷尺（刻度精确），旁边有测距轮、米尺、标志桶和测影子的立竿，适合长度测量课。", "stand": {"ground_y": 880, "x": [300, 1600]}, "subtitle": [0, 950, 1920, 1060], "layers": [{"name": "sky", "enter": "fade", "delay": 0, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "clouds", "enter": "slide-l", "delay": 0.2, "loop": "drift", "depth": null}, {"name": "school", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.25, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "trees", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.4, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}, {"name": "fence", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.35, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "grass", "enter": "rise", "delay": 0.1, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "gnomon", "enter": "grow", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "meter_stick", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.6, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "tape", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.5, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "cones", "enter": "pop", "delay": 0.7, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "wheel", "enter": "slide-r", "delay": 0.8, "loop": null, "depth": null}, {"name": "flags", "enter": "drop", "delay": 0.9, "loop": "sway", "depth": null}], "palette": {"sky1": "#86CDF2", "sky2": "#E6F6FF", "sun": "#FFD36E", "school": "#F6D7B8", "school2": "#E9BE95", "roof": "#E2765E", "win": "#A9D6F2", "fence": "#FFFFFF", "fence2": "#D9E3EA", "tree": "#5FAE74", "tree2": "#9AD48B", "trunk": "#8A5A3A", "grass1": "#9FD27E", "grass2": "#7DBE5F", "grass3": "#B6E09A", "tape": "#F7C94A", "tape2": "#E2A92A", "tick": "#3A3A3A", "cone": "#F2784B", "cone2": "#FFFFFF", "wheel": "#3F7FC2", "metal": "#8C98A4", "flag1": "#E85D4F", "flag2": "#3FA7D6", "ruler": "#F4E3B5", "shadow": "#5E8F4A"}}
